newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Midland Realty jumps after strong results.
newsitem.headline: Midland Realty jumps after strong results.

text.p: Shares of Midland Realty (Holdings) Ltd rose on Tuesday after the company reported strong growth in 1996 earnings and proposed a bonus share issue, brokers said.

"Investors were seen rushing in for the stock after the company reported sharp profit growth of almost four times its previous earnings, and a distribution of bonus shares," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
Midland Realty shares were up HK$0.90 or 11.39 percent to HK$8.80 in late morning after hitting a high of HK$9.00. Volume was 5.8 million shares worth HK$50.87 million.

The property agency posted a profit of HK$300.01 million for the year ended in December 1996, compared with HK$77.54 million the year before. It also proposed a bonus issue of three new shares for every two shares held.
